open_points.subject: update_progress_photo
open_points.text: - update_progress_photo: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST validate optional section project scope, change only caption/section/client_visible/updated_at/updated_by, and append AuditAction.PHOTO_UPDATE atomically without changing file_ref, progress, or finance.
open_points.other_text: - update_progress_photo: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open exactly one transaction, read the photo only through tx.progress_photos().get_progress_photo with photo_id, resolve a supplied section only through tx.project_sections().get_project_section with context.project_id inside that same transaction, write only through tx.progress_photos().update_progress_photo, append the audit only through tx.audit(), and on success commit exactly once (a replay or a validation failure closes it by rollback instead); it MUST NOT call validate_project_section, open a second transaction while its own is active, or use a legacy transaction-level photo or project-section method. These are ProgressPhotoRepository and ProjectSectionRepository operations; the same-named legacy PortalTransaction methods are never called.
open_points.question: Must every non-validation update write and append PHOTO_UPDATE atomically, or is there an update replay path that rolls back without writing or auditing? Remove “a replay or” or define and exempt that replay path from the orchestration requirement.
